artworks.title: Mt. Colognola - Sheep Grazing on Lake Trasimeno
artworks.medium: gouache and charcoal on light brown paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a view framed by trees, guiding the observer's gaze towards an open area. The horizon is positioned near the middle of the composition, with hints of distant fields or water visible through the gaps between the trees. The artwork features a sketch-like technique using soft, textured brushstrokes to depict foliage and landscape elements. The color scheme primarily consists of earthy browns and muted whites, with subtle contrasts for light and shadow effects under the tree canopy. The interplay of negative space and dense texture conveys light filtering through the leaves, creating a tranquil ambiance.

artworks.title: Vitré
artworks.medium: gouache, crayon, and watercolor on gray  wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow, rocky pathway leading up to a unique structure with a distinct roof and a circular window above an archway. The view is straight ahead with steep rock cliffs framing the pathway and the building in the background. The painting style features textured brushstrokes, giving a rough appearance to the rocks and a detailed look to the foliage. The color palette includes dark greys and browns for the rocks and staircase, with touches of green from plants. The building is portrayed in warmer hues like light tan and brown, standing out against the darker tones. The sky is overcast with patches of pale, cloudy tones.

artworks.title: Drawing for Star of Fortune
artworks.medium: crayon and black chalk on brown paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The sculpture is a carved relief depicting a nude woman seated on a circular medallion. She is holding a branch or leaf above her head with one hand, and the other hand rests on a horn of plenty filled with fruits near her feet. The background features a horizon with a sun to the left and the number "1892" carved prominently near the sun. The material appears to be a bronze or bronze-like metal, giving it a rich brown color with varying light and dark tones where the relief catches the light. The presentation shows a blend of natural elements and the human form harmoniously arranged on the round surface.

artworks.title: Ceiling with Allegorical Figures and the Arms of Pope Sixtus V (Guerra's outer drawing); Saint Joseph and the Christ Child (Viani's central drawing)
artworks.artist: Giovanni Guerra and Domenico Maria Viani
artworks.date: outer drawing c. 1587; central drawing after 1690; attachments c. 1700-1725
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on heavy laid paper (outer drawing); graphite on heavy laid paper (central drawing); gold leaf borders and paper cut-outs adhered to oculi (Talman additions)
artworks.dimensions:
center section (octagon): 23.3 x 16.2 cm (9 3/16 x 6 3/8 in.)
Overall (ceiling design): 51.1 x 41.8 cm (20 1/8 x 16 7/16 in.)
mount: 53.3 x 44 cm (21 x 17 5/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is an image of a decorative ceiling design. The central panel features a seated adult figure interacting with a child, with the adult holding a staff and the child perched on a ledge. Surrounding this central image are ornate borders and panels filled with foliate designs, putti, and architectural elements in a brownish hue. The overall design suggests a grand interior ceiling or mural with a symmetrical and classical decoration.

artworks.title: Mary Wood
artworks.medium: pastel on paper laid down on canvas
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a woman positioned in profile, facing to the left. She has delicate facial features with a soft complexion and slightly pink cheeks. Her hair is light-colored, curly, voluminous, and styled elegantly. The woman is dressed in a white garment with ruffled detailing and a light pink sash around her waist. The background is a muted dark color.

artworks.title: Illusionistic Architecture for the Vault of San Ignazio
artworks.medium: pen and gray and brown ink with gray wash on two joined sheets of heavy laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert M. and Anne T. Bass
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural ceiling or dome structure, viewed from below. The design includes geometric patterns, arches, and detailed embellishments. The use of perspective enhances the three-dimensionality of the structure. The shading delineates the angles and surfaces of the architectural elements.

artworks.title: The Holy Family in the Carpenter's Shop
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray wash, watercolor, white gouache, and touches of brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "L'Affaire Clémenceau"
artworks.medium: etching in black on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals. The first person is a man sitting in a chair at a desk or table, shown from the waist up. He leans to his side, resting his chin on his hand, with his gaze directed downward. His facial features include a moustache, furrowed brow, and curly hair. He is dressed in a dark coat with a closed collar. On the desk in front of him are a stack of books and a large open book. The second individual is a woman shown reclined, likely asleep or resting on a soft surface. Her body is depicted from head to knee, lying with an arm outstretched across what appears to be a cushion or pillow. Her facial features are delicate, with eyes closed and long, flowing hair cascading around her head. She is draped in a fabric or light garment. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Pierre Copies the Virgin from the Portal of the Church of Marly (Pierre Copie la Vierge du Portail de L'Église de Marly)
artworks.medium: etching in black on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing on the left side under an archway, while a group consisting of two adults and an infant is seated on steps on the right side. The standing person has dark hair and wears a long dark garment. The individual is facing the group with their hand resting against their garment. One adult in the group wears a suit or jacket and the other adult, possibly a woman, has long hair and is holding an infant wrapped up. In the background, there are buildings, trees, and a sunlit setting visible through an open archway framing the scene.

artworks.title: The Letter to Madame Henry (La lettre à Madame Henry)
artworks.medium: etching in black on cream Arches laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a suit and bowler hat reading a paper, with two other figures partially visible to the left. The background features a textured wall and paving.

artworks.title: Sadness (Tristesse)
artworks.medium: etching on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a person in a side profile. The person is seated, with their head slightly turned to the side and their hand resting against their cheek. The facial features are detailed, showing a contemplative expression. The hair is short and curly, contrasting with the smoother parts of the face. The individual is wearing a dark, textured garment, possibly a coat or robe. Surrounding them are floral motifs and a wooden surface in the background.

artworks.title: The Doll (La Poupée)
artworks.medium: etching and roulette in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a large stuffed doll or puppet against a textured surface. The color palette is sepia-toned. The doll is positioned centrally, with its body slumped slightly forward against a structure, and its head tilted to one side. The background and surrounding areas are shaded with line work.

artworks.title: Melancholy (Mélancolie)
artworks.medium: etching and softground etching in brown on  Arches laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body view of a person positioned slightly turned to the left, gazing into the distance. The person's face is depicted in profile, capturing delicate and slightly angular facial features with a focused or contemplative expression. Their hair is tousled, falling in loose waves around the head. They are draped in heavy, textured clothing that wraps around their shoulders. In the background, the image is set against a textured surface with abstract, organic line work. The overall composition has a sketch-like quality.

artworks.title: Back of a Woman (Dos de Femme)
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image depicts an artistic rendering of a person's upper body, shown from the back, and without clothing. The person is seated and turned away from the viewer, with their upper torso and head displayed. The head is slightly bent forward and to the side, with long hair that appears loosely gathered, suggesting the style of a bun or ponytail. The lines of the drawing are textured and abstracted, giving a sense of depth and contour to the figure's form. There are no visible facial features due to the angle and style of the depiction. The surrounding area is filled with dense, hatched lines, creating a dark, lightly patterned background that contrasts with the lighter figure. The setting appears to be inside, as indicated by the enclosed space and the straight, horizontal line that may suggest a piece of furniture or architectural detail. There are no other objects or jewelry present in the image.

artworks.title: Woman in a Cape (La Femme à la Pelerine)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and roulette on imitation vellum paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the waist up, positioned in a three-quarter view facing the left while looking back over their shoulder towards the viewer. The person's facial features are softly rendered with minimal detail, and their hair appears to be light-colored and curly, blending into the surrounding dark tones. The individual is wearing a garment that covers their upper body fully and is depicted against a deep, shadowy background. The lower portion of the image is largely abstract, with vertical and diagonal lines. The setting is devoid of any specific context, maintaining a focus on the figure and the interplay of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Eve before the Apple Tree (Eve de dos devant le pommier)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image depicts an etching of a person standing in a natural setting. The figure is viewed from the back, standing upright with hair tied back. The face is not shown. The person is nude and there are no visible clothing or accessories. Surrounding the individual is a tree on the left side, with branches and fruit. The foreground features tall grass and two small animals that resemble rabbits. The background shows a landscape with minimal detailing to emphasize the person and tree. The word "EVE" is inscribed near the bottom right, along with a signature.

artworks.title: Woman in Full Profile (Grand profil de femme)
artworks.medium: etching in brown on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: This artwork depicts a portrait showing the upper part of a person's body, from the shoulders up. The individual is positioned in a profile view, facing to the right. The person's facial features suggest a thoughtful or contemplative expression, with a straight nose and high cheekbones visible. Their hair is dark and styled in a loose updo with soft waves. The person is wearing a dark garment, which appears to drape over the shoulders. There are no visible jewelry or other objects. The background of the image consists of vertical and diagonal lines, creating a textured effect that frames the person's profile. The texture and shading give the artwork a textured and dimensional appearance.

artworks.title: Eve
artworks.medium: etching in yellow on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a nude figure in a reclining pose. The body is oriented slightly sideways, facing left, and the head is tilted slightly downward. The facial features are soft and partially shaded, with closed eyes and a relaxed expression. The hair is long with gentle waves falling down past the shoulders. The person seems to be holding a long piece of fabric or garment draped over one shoulder and extending down the back. The background is textured with dark, sketch-like shading interspersed with lighter areas for contrast around the figure.

artworks.title: Eve
artworks.medium: etching in brown on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a nude individual. The full body is depicted in a standing position, slightly leaning back. The person's left arm is bent at the elbow and raised, with the forearm resting across the neck and face, partially obscuring the facial features. The head is tilted slightly in profile to the left, with wavy, medium-length hair flowing naturally. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the person's hands. The background consists of dark, diagonal hatching lines that provide texture. The artist's signature is at the bottom right of the engraving.

artworks.title: Madame Aman Jean
artworks.medium: etching in brown on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's upper body with a focus on the face and some indication of the shoulders. The person is in a contemplative pose, with their hand supporting their chin. The facial features are softly rendered, with the eyes shaded and a subtle shading around the nose and mouth. The person has long hair that falls over their shoulders. They are wearing a garment with a high neckline, but the clothing details are not clearly outlined. The background is a cross-hatched circular area surrounding the figure, with neutral tones creating a vignette-like framing effect.

artworks.title: Three Veiled Women (Trois femmes voilées)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: Three figures are depicted, focusing on their upper bodies. The central figure is seated and hunched forward, wrapped in a cloak that partially conceals their form. The face is downturned, with short, dark hair, and simple facial features outlined with soft lines. On either side of the central figure are two other figures, also wrapped in cloaks, standing and facing toward each other. One on the left has long, flowing hair and distinct facial features with a calm expression, while the other on the right has detailed facial features and their hair covered by the hood of the cloak. The clothing on all the figures is similar, consisting of large cloaks that create a sense of unity among them. There is no jewelry or objects in their hands visible in the etching. The background is plain, with no distinct features, focusing the attention entirely on the cloaked figures.

artworks.title: Auguste Rodin
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed illustration of a man's profile view. The man has a prominent nose, a full beard, and his eyes are partially closed. His head is turned to the right, revealing a receding hairline with short hair on the back. He appears to be wearing a garment like a cloak or robe. The background is plain, in a light color, and there are no discernible patterns or objects. The sketch is in a soft, textured style with varying line thickness, and the artist's signature is in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Cast of a Net (Le coup de filet)
artworks.medium: etching on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: This image depicts a skeletal figure with an imposing cloak standing over a body of water. Two floating heads are also present, with one being more prominent. The background includes a sea with horizontal lines and a sky with swirling lines and clouds.

artworks.title: Woman at Her Toilette (La toilette)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a person seated in a three-quarter view with their body slightly turned. The person's facial features are depicted with light shadowing, wearing a broad-brimmed hat that partially covers their face. The person's dark hair is mostly hidden by the hat. They are shown nude, holding a drape or piece of fabric across their body. The scene around them is softly shaded with hatching, creating a textured backdrop. The background is filled with cross-hatched lines for depth and shadowing without specific details.
